name: sandbox
title: Sandbox Execution
description: 在沙盒运行代码并处理真实文件。
input_contract: Use sandbox_run to generate source-code deliverables under /mnt/data with a real execution trace; use write tools for ordinary non-code text; import before reading/editing and publish generated outputs.
